recognize_zh: 箭頭所指細胞核內有一個圓形淡粉紅色的假包涵體（Dutcher body，免疫球蛋白堆積於核內），周圍為小至中型、染色質粗塊的淋巴漿細胞樣細胞；右下插圖抹片見偏心核、嗜鹼性細胞質的淋巴漿細胞，支持淋巴漿細胞性淋巴瘤。
features: Diffuse infiltrate of small to medium lymphoid cells with clumped, coarse chromatin
Admixed plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with eccentric nuclei
Dutcher body: pale eosinophilic, round intranuclear pseudoinclusion (arrow) displacing chromatin to the periphery
Occasional larger cells with vesicular nuclei; no sheets of large cells
Inset smear: lymphoplasmacytic cell with eccentric nucleus, basophilic cytoplasm and perinuclear hof
describe_en: Section shows a diffuse infiltrate of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with coarse chromatin. A Dutcher body, a pale eosinophilic intranuclear pseudoinclusion of immunoglobulin, is identified (arrow). The inset smear demonstrates a lymphoplasmacytic cell with an eccentric nucleus and basophilic cytoplasm. Findings are consistent with a B-cell lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation, most suggestive of lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma, to be supported by an IgM paraprotein, a light-chain-restricted plasma cell component and MYD88 L265P mutation.

ddx.dx: Marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Dutcher bodies also occur in MZL; marginal zone/monocytoid cells, lymphoepithelial lesions and absence of MYD88 L265P favor MZL.
Myeloma consists of a pure plasma cell population (CD138+, CD19-/CD45-) without an accompanying clonal B-lymphocyte component and usually has a non-IgM paraprotein.

ddx.dx: Chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma with plasmacytoid features
ddx.vs: Shows proliferation centers and CD5+/CD23+/LEF1+ phenotype rather than a CD5-negative lymphoplasmacytic population.
Reactive plasma cells are polytypic without a clonal B-cell component, and Dutcher bodies are uncommon.
